items.summary: Nigeria partner-network users get 50 MB daily, up to 1.5 GB monthly, with no form, subscription or promo code. Jan–Sep2026 free data total 5,538 TB; 30bn page loads, 2.9bn searches, 378m news reads. Article discusses affordability and existing server-side compression (claimed up to 90%), compatibility with low-resource/slow-network devices, education/business/entertainment/community uses, and intent to continue expansion. It explicitly says free data has existed for years; no new country/network/date/version expansion established.
